pages.title: Transfinite Weave
pages.text: A cloth woven with more threads than there are natural numbers to count them - an uncountable weave in the honest Cantorian sense. It drapes like silk, and every thread is visible no matter how close I look. The endgame assemblies are stitched on it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cantor showed some infinities are larger than others. I used an aleph-null shard as the warp and let a cosmic processor diagonalise across it to produce the weft. The result was a cloth that cannot be listed.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.
